diff --git a/tests/test_catalog.py b/tests/test_catalog.py
index e6d8db9..e562e51 100644
--- a/tests/test_catalog.py
+++ b/tests/test_catalog.py
@@ -1,5 +1,17 @@
-from toyapp.catalog import browse
+from toyapp.catalog import browse, browse_next
+from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage


 def test_direct_catalog_page():
     assert browse(["a", "b", "c"], page=2, per_page=2).items == ["c"]
+
+
+def test_catalog_next_page_walks_forward():
+    first = browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], per_page=2)
+    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
+    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
+    assert first.has_more
+    second = browse_next(["a", "b", "c"], first.next_cursor, per_page=2)
+    assert second.items == ["c"]
+    assert second.next_cursor is None
+    assert not second.has_more
diff --git a/tests/test_pagination.py b/tests/test_pagination.py
index c373425..75c0b8c 100644
--- a/tests/test_pagination.py
+++ b/tests/test_pagination.py
@@ -1,6 +1,7 @@
 import pytest

-from toyapp.pagination import page_numbers, paginate
+from toyapp.pagination import CursorPage, page_numbers, paginate, paginate_cursor
+from toyapp.tokens import decode_offset, encode_offset


 def test_page_number_api_remains_one_based() -> None:
@@ -12,3 +13,36 @@ def test_page_number_validation_is_preserved() -> None:
     with pytest.raises(ValueError):
         paginate(["a"], page=0, per_page=1)
     assert page_numbers(5, 2) == [1, 2, 3]
+
+
+def test_cursor_page_walks_forward_and_preserves_order() -> None:
+    first = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c"], per_page=2)
+    assert isinstance(first, CursorPage)
+    assert first.items == ["a", "b"]
+    assert first.next_cursor == encode_offset(2)
+    assert first.has_more
+    second = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c"], first.next_cursor, per_page=2)
+    assert second.items == ["c"]
+    assert second.next_cursor is None
+    assert not second.has_more
+
+
+def test_cursor_page_has_more_matches_next_cursor() -> None:
+    page = paginate_cursor(["a", "b", "c", "d"], per_page=2)
+    assert page.next_cursor is not None
+    assert page.has_more
+    assert decode_offset(page.next_cursor) == 2
+
+
+def test_cursor_page_empty_and_past_end() -> None:
+    empty = paginate_cursor([], per_page=2)
+    assert empty == CursorPage([], None, False)
+    past_end = paginate_cursor([1], encode_offset(100), per_page=2)
+    assert past_end == CursorPage([], None, False)
+
+
+def test_cursor_page_validation() -> None:
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        paginate_cursor([1, 2], per_page=0)
+    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
+        paginate_cursor([1, 2], "%%%")
diff --git a/toyapp/catalog.py b/toyapp/catalog.py
index 976c0a5..595c584 100644
--- a/toyapp/catalog.py
+++ b/toyapp/catalog.py
@@ -1,9 +1,13 @@
-"""The existing catalog supports direct page-number access."""
+"""The catalog supports direct page-number and next-page cursor browsing."""
 from typing import Sequence, TypeVar
-from .pagination import Page, paginate
+from .pagination import CursorPage, Page, paginate, paginate_cursor

 T = TypeVar("T")


 def browse(items: Sequence[T], page: int = 1, per_page: int = 20) -> Page[T]:
     return paginate(items, page, per_page)
+
+
+def browse_next(items: Sequence[T], cursor: str | None = None, per_page: int = 20) -> CursorPage[T]:
+    return paginate_cursor(items, cursor, per_page)
diff --git a/toyapp/pagination.py b/toyapp/pagination.py
index 4c91fb2..500fc82 100644
--- a/toyapp/pagination.py
+++ b/toyapp/pagination.py
@@ -45,6 +45,25 @@ def page_numbers(total_items: int, per_page: int) -> list[int]:
     return list(range(1, ceil(total_items / per_page) + 1))


+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class CursorPage(Generic[T]):
+    items: list[T]
+    next_cursor: str | None
+    has_more: bool
+
+
+def paginate_cursor(items: Sequence[T], cursor: str | None = None, per_page: int = 20) -> CursorPage[T]:
+    """Return one page of items, addressed by an opaque cursor."""
+    from .tokens import decode_offset, encode_offset
+
+    if per_page < 1:
+        raise ValueError("per_page must be >= 1")
+    offset = decode_offset(cursor)
+    page = list(items[offset:offset + per_page])
+    end = offset + len(page)
+    next_cursor = encode_offset(end) if end < len(items) else None
+    return CursorPage(items=page, next_cursor=next_cursor, has_more=next_cursor is not None)
+

 @dataclass(frozen=True)
 class ExportWindow(Generic[T]):
